title: Milestone Approach Uplift on Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements Retroactive Claims
content:
A retroactive points claim on a Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements agreement is uplifted by how close the agreement stands to its spend milestone. **Rule.** The claim's milestone approach is the spend posted to the agreement in its current agreement year — taken as every spend entry on the agreement less every agreement-year reset entry — as a percentage of the tier's spend milestone. The milestone approach adds an approach uplift:

| Milestone approach | Uplift |
|---|---|
| 95 percent of the spend milestone or more | 10 percentage points |
| 80 percent or more, and below 95 percent | 5 percentage points |
| below 80 percent | nothing |

**How the uplift acts.** The uplift is counted in percentage points; claim uplifts on different grounds are added together, and the claim points are raised by the total: the uplifted claim points are the claim points multiplied by one hundred plus the total uplift, divided by one hundred, rounded down to the whole point.

### The spend levels per tier

| Tier | Spend milestone (USD) | 80 percent (USD) | 95 percent (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Business Connect | 50000 | 40000 | 47500 |
| Crestline Business Connect Plus | 100000 | 80000 | 95000 |
| Crestline Corporate Select | 250000 | 200000 | 237500 |
| Crestline Corporate Preferred | 1000000 | 800000 | 950000 |
| Crestline Corporate Premier | 2500000 | 2000000 | 2375000 |
| Crestline Corporate Strategic | 7500000 | 6000000 | 7125000 |

### Cases (hypothetical)

- A Crestline Corporate Select agreement whose spend entries total USD 610000.00 and whose reset entries total USD 370000.00 has a current-year spend of USD 240000.00, which is 96 percent of 250000: uplift of 10 percentage points.
- A Crestline Business Connect Plus agreement with a current-year spend of USD 80000.00 stands at exactly 80 percent: uplift of 5 percentage points.
- Claim points of 483 raised by 10 percentage points alone: 483 multiplied by 110 and divided by one hundred is 531.3, rounded down to 531.
